item.title: COMMUNITY | Mickey Thomas to run the United Airlines NYC Half Marathon
item.description: Club legend Mickey Thomas and a team from the Wrexham AFC Foundation will run the United Airlines New York City Half Marathon next month to raise funds for the Foundation’s twinning partnership with Kick4Life. The 13.2-mile run will take place on Sunday, March 15, and will feature Mickey and a Foundation contingent starting at Prospect Park, running over the Brooklyn Bridge, and through Times Square before finishing in Central Park. item.title: #WXMANORAK | Wrexham AFC 2-1 Portsmouth
item.description: Wrexham dug deep to follow up their spectacular win over Ipswich Town with a hard-fought victory over Portsmouth at the STōK Cae Ras. item.title: FIXTURE NEWS | Wrexham AFC Women vs Cardiff City to be hosted at STōK Cae Ras
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women’s Genero Adran Premier fixture against Cardiff City on Sunday, March 29, will now be hosted at the SToK Cae Ras.
